rule.alternative: If support fails, every measured model-calling optimizer must tidy-refuse in Node and in native when it finishes, and unchanged offline-state regression evidence must pass for at least BootstrapFewShot. rule.refused: Otherwise record the failing probes and reason. Sync entry points are refused when tidy: aforward and acall are migration guidance, not an alternative procedure. A completing sync member is a finding, not uniform sync support.
rule.workerHazard: A Node silent success, unfixed code, post-termination request or hang triggers the conditional fixed-refusal unit. Rerun affected probes once; stop without an outcome if this would change a locked artifact or wheel manifest hash.
rule.nativeThreads: A native-only failure caused by an extra thread is recorded and linked to galaxie-fv4.3.18; it does not trigger the Worker-only conditional unit or change the outcome.
